assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only peach-girl:okayasu-ryo@manga#second-pass-character-monograph (PEACH_GIRL_RYO_MONOGRAPH.md, version 1.0, active_provisional) and peach-girl:okayasu-ryo@manga#time-indexed-literary-dossier (PEACH_GIRL_RYO_TIME_INDEXED_RECONSTRUCTION_DOSSIER.md, version 1.0, active_provisional) at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the original Japanese 新装版 manga V01-V18, in which Ryō appears only through others' reports in V08-V09 and is first identified and present from V10. The Peach Girl current-state and corpus map was read for method, authority order and scope only. The volume readings, the four longitudinal ledgers, the source receipts, the second-pass reconciliation and coverage reassessment, the reconstruction assessment and tests, the ensemble study and the other characters' monographs and dossiers are not curated evidence on this subject and nothing is borrowed from them. No anime, live-action, sequel or related-manga material is included, and the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Nine dossier states from R-01 (after V10 i0093) to R-09 (after V18 i0070), each stopping after all panels on its named image: R-01 and R-02 in V10, R-03 in V11, R-04 in V13, R-05 in V16, R-06 to R-08 in V17 and R-09 in V18. V12, V14 and V15 have no state, and the V08-V18 phase table is expressly later-informed navigation, not knowledge at an interval's start. The monograph's account runs from the V08-V09 reported brother to V18. No default state is designated, so a cutoff must be named. Anything after V18 i0070, including actual parenting, restitution, a reconciled relationship with Misao and long-term reform, is expressly unshown, and no in-world calendar dates are fixed.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The monograph states a governing reading: Ryō offers the feeling of being understood, then uses the access it creates on terms the other person did not accept, and his useful perception is part of that mechanism; the narrative needs a distinction between a changing capacity to feel and a demonstrated willingness to account for what he does. The dossier's mechanism table gives four context-sensitive mechanisms (credibility recruits access, exit costs preserve control, selective tenderness and responsibility diverge, vulnerability can prompt control or reversal), each with a failure boundary. B is not supported: R-05 says jealous frustration, fear of obligation and self-protection are plausible candidates whose hierarchy is not supplied, R-02 says his complete purpose is not depicted, and the dossier refuses one timeless personality rule. D is rejected because the reading is tested against located counterevidence (actual aid, V17 cancellation).

The dossier gives nine image-exact states R-01 to R-09 with knowledge, mechanism and unavailable sections, and separates commission (V17 i0097), the family offer (R-06, i0110), cancellation before impact (R-07, i0112) and the received nonpregnancy account (R-08, i0150). The monograph orders the development from reported brother through V10 credibility and override, V11 divergent accounts, V13 earnings and exit price, V14-V16 selective tenderness and evasion, V17 commission and cancellation, to the V18 belated wish. B is not supported: V12, V14 and V15 have no state, three of nine states fall in V17, the phase table is expressly not knowledge at an interval's start, no challenge vectors are listed, and both artifacts come from the same second-pass authorship. D is rejected because the selected states are exact and separate own, received and reader knowledge.

A monograph section and the dossier's written-presentation section locate speech acts by recipient and modality: the considerate false proxy explanation to Momo Adachi (V10 i0093), the short 帰さない (V10 i0169), なーんちゃって and バイバイももちゃん after disarming her (V11 i0082-i0083), incompatible accounts of the same assault to Sae Kashiwagi, Kairi Okayasu and Momo (V11), the quiet 計画は中止だ to the hired man (V17 i0112) and the tentative parenting wish (V18 i0070). The monograph says recipient, modality and action distinguish these utterances more reliably than an imagined single conversational voice, and the dossier says no complete conversational voice is recoverable. C is not supported: there is no register inventory or acoustic delivery. E is rejected because the speech functions are analyzed across volumes.

Ordinary-seeming occasions are located only as settings of the coercive or commercial plot: the café counsel and party (V10), the game-research questionnaire (V10), the bounded hospital help with repayment terms (V14-V15), the amusement-park date with Sae that turns into an argument for replacing her and abandoning the pregnancy she alleges (V17) and studying parenting-site pictures (V18). The dossier states that ordinary conduct with strangers is unestablished and business scope is unadjudicated. D is not supported because no ordinary domain is analyzed as such. NOT_ASSESSED is rejected because these occasions are located and given meaning.

Differentiated conduct is located toward Momo (useful counsel, phone deception, narrowed and overridden permission, confinement, bathroom disarming), Sae (accepting earnings, the conditional exit price, the V16 blow, denial, reproductive pressure, the commissioned attack and later emergency priority), Misao (protection during the attack, tender reception of her confession, the address Aki, her withdrawal and demand for responsibility) and Kairi (rival account of the brothers' past, the loyalty-test framing, hospital help with repayment demands). The dossier's mechanism 'selective tenderness and responsibility diverge' and the monograph's audience-specific accounts make the differentiation explicit. B is not supported: no matched-recipient rule is given and earlier relationships are unestablished.

Interior claims rest on his own avowals: before Sae's family offer he voices fear of his own offspring and envy of Kairi's ability to be loved (V17 i0097-i0110); he says he had thought his feeling for Misao one-sided before her admission (V15-V16); and he says raising a child might have been worth trying (V18 i0070). The monograph calls these his expressed self-understanding, not genetic facts or a diagnosis. R-06 treats the i0110 widened eyes and heartbeat marks as a strong affective cue, not a commitment. C is not supported: R-02 and R-05 state his complete purpose and the hierarchy of his motives are not supplied. E is rejected because located self-accounts are analyzed.

Located conflict conduct is differentiated by occasion: pulling Momo back and saying 帰さない after she says she is leaving (V10 i0168-i0169), the locked room and seizure in V11, the feigned pain that dislodges her defensive spray and his self-controlled exit (V11 i0082-i0083), the conditional exit price offered to Sae (V13 i0101), the unhesitating blow to Sae (V16), pressure with a pill and money (V17), and the commissioned attack followed by an actual cancellation before impact (V17 i0097, i0112). The dossier's exit-cost mechanism names bodily restraint, changed accounts and financial conditions as distinct routes, with Momo's defenses as counterevidence to omnipotence. B is not supported: the dossier rejects any global manipulation recipe and gives no escalation rule.

His own located ethical speech is mostly self-justification or late acknowledgment: the protective shock-treatment account of the V13 filming job with an admission that the business is improper, the claim that he acted badly for Sae's benefit (rejected by Misao), saying the attack was his fault and identifying himself as the father at the hospital, and acknowledging in V18 that failure cannot simply be reset. Most of the ethical structure is the analysts' distinction between feeling and accountability. C is not supported: no deliberation procedure is given and his stated reasons do not predict his conduct. E is rejected because these first-person frames are located and set against his acts.

Play is located only as tactic or idiom: the explicit joke なーんちゃって revealing feigned pain to disarm Momo (V11 i0082), sexual presumption mixed with apology in the same scene, his boast of writing scenarios, and the game comparison in the V18 parenting wish, which the dossier reads as his established idiom. D is not supported because no humor repertoire, timing or range is described. NOT_ASSESSED is rejected because these instances are located and analyzed for what they do.

Both artifacts route claims to image coordinates (PG-JP-NE-VNN-W01 iNNNN) across V08-V18 and to the all-18 source-first record: the analyst's complete original reading of V06-V10, attributed peer readings elsewhere and selected original-resolution repeats. They disclose prior exposure and no blind corroboration, keep the V08-V09 reports and the unnamed V10 hospital visitor apart from the identified man, and leave business scope, earlier relationships and the deceased アキ chronology unestablished. The evaluator could not recheck the receipts, ledgers or readings, which are outside the set, and owner acceptance is pending. B is not supported.

Affirmative limits and corrections are located: the V10 hospital visitor at i0022 is not merged with him; Morika's knife attack is real rather than a paint prop; no actual payment or rescue by Ryō is shown in V13 and no completed intercourse is established there; no drug ingestion is established in V17; the club strikes Sae's back at V17 i0123 and the later abdominal report at i0130 is separately attributed; the nonpregnancy account is not shown to be a deliberate fake; and the deceased アキ, Misao's surname 安芸 and his address Aki remain distinct identity questions. These are documented within two same-authored artifacts and are not independently audited, so B is not supported.

The dossier's temporal contract stops each state after all panels on its named image, makes later events in the same volume unavailable unless received by an established route, and separates reader knowledge, another person's memory, reported information and direct participation (R-04: Sae's remembered images are her focalized experience, not his knowledge). The V17 split into R-06, R-07 and R-08 is fine-grained. B is not supported: no leakage vectors are listed, V12, V14 and V15 have no state, and the phase table is expressly retrospective. D is rejected because every selected state is image-exact with an unavailable section.

scenario_readiness.note: The evidence analyzes a handful of situated written speech acts and states that no complete conversational voice, exact invented next line or acoustic voice is recoverable. Lines written for Ryō beyond the analyzed forms would be fluent invention rather than source-supported voice. This bounds the evidence set, not Ryō's actual speech.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: Any named dossier state R-01 to R-09 or an equally exact V10-V18 cutoff; no state after V18 i0070.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Any counterpart, including Momo, Sae, Misao and Kairi as the evidence describes them at the named cutoff; the refusal does not depend on the partner.
setting_constraints: Crossover, counterfactual or materially novel contexts outside the canon cutoffs
Business, legal, financial, parenting or clinical situations, and conduct with strangers
Behavioral or dialogue simulation rather than retrieval of a canon state

scenario_readiness.note: The dossier's unsupported-domains section leaves business scope, every earlier relationship, the deceased Aki chronology, ordinary conduct with strangers and durable post-ending change unestablished and abstains from exact new behavior; its states are retrieval cards for canon cutoffs, not a basis for a materially novel context.

Ordinary occasions are located only inside the coercive or commercial plot, and the dossier states ordinary conduct with strangers is unestablished. No procedure for an unfamiliar ordinary scene is given.

His located ethical speech is largely self-justification or late acknowledgment, and the evidence shows his stated reasons diverging from his acts; it abstains on durable change. No procedure for a new ethical choice by Ryō can be run on this evidence set.

conditions: A dossier state R-01 to R-09 or an equally exact V10-V18 cutoff is named; no default state is assumed and no information after the cutoff or unreceived by Ryō is used, including Sae's or Momo's focalized memories.
The partner is Sae or Misao as the evidence describes her at that cutoff; the R-01 to R-03 episodes with Momo are retrieved as deception, overridden refusal and confinement, never as a romance.
Output is a description of Ryō's accessible knowledge and actual conduct with the dossier's abstentions kept; no quoted dialogue is produced as canon and no sexual content is generated.
Narrowed or earlier assent never authorizes later contact; Sae's attachment or return never authorizes the V13 coercion; tenderness toward Misao and the V16 blow to Sae are both represented.
Both the V17 commission and the actual cancellation are represented; no outcome after V18 i0070, restitution, reconciliation with Misao or actual parenting is asserted.
scenario_readiness.note: The romantic evidence is concentrated in his relationships with Sae (R-04 and R-06 to R-08) and Misao (R-05 with the monograph's V15-V17 account), and each named state supplies his accessible knowledge, located conduct and unavailable facts. Readiness is conditional because the supported use is retrieval and bounded description at a canon cutoff, not prediction of a new romantic outcome; no vectors are executed and operational acceptance is blocked.

His adult work appears only as a polished commercial environment with a research pretext, membership promises, earnings and an introduced filming job, and both artifacts state that business scope is unestablished and that accusations of crime or police connections are characters' claims, not adjudicated facts. No workplace behavior beyond the located episodes can be supported.

known_limits.statement: The dossier separates literary reconstruction from accepted operational prediction or unrestricted conversation; it is BOUNDED_PROVISIONAL for manual literary state retrieval, its proposed checks are UNEXECUTED, and the monograph says a bounded dossier cannot invent the private history or validated behavioral rule the source has not supplied.

No fresh held-out source remains in the exposed all-18 run; the dossier supplies no operational validation, calibrated probability or readiness promotion, and operational acceptance is BLOCKED_NO_HELD_OUT_VALIDATION.

Useful counsel and actual material aid rebut 'every act fake'; direct refusal overrides and conditional exit costs rebut 'help proves safety'; the actual V17 cancellation rebuts 'no local reversal'; the original commission and absence of sustained amends rebut 'redeemed'. None of these mechanisms may become one timeless personality rule.

Reader knowledge and other characters' memories are not Ryō's knowledge, recipients of his incompatible accounts do not share one version, and later events (the cancellation, injuries, the nonpregnancy account, the V18 wish) cannot be installed in an earlier state.

The V08-V09 reported brother, the unnamed V10 hospital visitor, the identified man, the deceased アキ, Misao (安芸操, whom he calls Aki) and the unnamed long-haired woman at V18 i0069-i0070 are not to be merged.

No actual payment or rescue by Ryō in V13, completed intercourse in V13, drug ingestion in V17, verified pregnancy or paternity, or deliberately faked pregnancy is established; legal liability, corruption and trafficking are characters' accusations, not adjudicated facts.

The cancellation, emergency priority, fault statement and V18 wish are real local acts, but no comprehensive confession, restitution, network accountability, actual child or durable behavioral change is depicted.

Business scope, every earlier relationship, the deceased Aki chronology, ordinary conduct with strangers and durable post-ending change remain unestablished; no diagnosis, legal adjudication or complete conversational voice may be supplied.

Both artifacts carry SECOND_PASS_SCOPED_SEMANTIC_REVIEW_PASSED_OWNER_ACCEPTANCE_PENDING, were authored and accepted within the project's own second pass with disclosed prior exposure and no blind corroboration, and are active_provisional.

V12, V14 and V15 have no exact state in the dossier, and V08-V09 present only reports about Ryō, so his state at those points can be described only through the monograph's account and the retrospective phase table.

The volume readings, four ledgers, source receipts, second-pass reconciliation and coverage reassessment, the reconstruction assessment and tests with its historical probes, and the ensemble study are not curated evidence on this subject, so their warrants were not rechecked here. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
